cases.note: W01 OS-font-family-name example is nonportable on hosted Mac (CoreText has no DejaVu Serif family despite TeX package filename availability); PDF-only, NOT Unicode proof.

cases.note: Text and math must be actual Unicode/XeLaTeX fontspec+unicode-math content within TikZ nodes. pdffonts evidence is separately marked NOT_CHECKED when tool is absent.
